bank_name: <the bank's name as the agent should say it>
opening_sentence: <the exact first sentence(s) the brief requires: who is calling and that the call is recorded, if required>
confirm_question: <the exact question that confirms the right person; keep the placeholders {title} and {last_name}>

confirmation.max_asks: <integer: how many times the question may be asked in total>

forbidden_before_verification: <words or topics that may not be said before identity is verified>
robot_answer: <what to say if asked whether the caller is a robot or an AI, as an instruction>
scam_answer: <what to say if asked whether this is a scam, as an instruction>

third_party.instructions: <the brief's rules when someone other than the customer answers, in full>
third_party.deceased_sentence: <the exact sentence to say when told the customer has died, if the brief gives one>

questions.field: <field name exactly as in the tool API enum>
questions.format: <format the tool needs, in words, plus any parsing rule from the brief>

identity.max_wrong_total: <integer: wrong answers in total that end the check>
identity.hint_value: <value of the tool's hint field that means the day and month were swapped, from the API file, or empty>
identity.hint_instruction: <what to do when that hint is returned, as an instruction>
identity.decline_rule: <the brief's rule when the customer does not want to answer, in full>
identity.on_fail_sentence: <what to tell a customer who failed the check, as a sentence to say>

debt_intro: <how to introduce the reason for the call once verified, as an instruction (which team, what about)>

product_words.<product type value from the API file>: <words to use for it; may contain {card_last4} or another field of the product>

floor_field.<product type value>: <field of the product that holds the minimum amount>

bands.name: <band name>
bands.deadline_business_days: <integer: the nth business day after today>

date_rules: <every rule about promise dates, in full, as instructions: validity, weekend or holiday handling, vague periods, this/next weekday, dates after the deadline>
amount_rules: <every rule about amounts, in full: what to ask first, the floor, offers above or below it, what may never be asked>
persuasion_rules: <every rule about refusals and persuasion attempts, in full: what counts as a refusal, what each attempt proposes, what to do when attempts are used up>
special_rules: <every rule for special situations, in full: hardship, already paid, dispute, does not want to talk, unknown information, and which rule comes first>
recording_rules: <every rule about the read-back, changes at the read-back, one promise per product, changing a recorded promise, and failed recordings>

sentences.confirm_question: <the exact confirmation question at the read-back>
sentences.after_promise: <the exact sentence to say after a recorded promise>

queues.restructuring: <queue value from the API file for a payment plan request>
queues.human: <queue value when the customer insists on a human>

unclear.outcome: <close_call outcome when the right person could not be confirmed>

multi_product.enabled: <true when customers can have several late products>
multi_product.rules: <every rule for several products, in full, or empty>

goodbye: <a closing sentence that thanks the customer and says goodbye>

rules.section: <one of: opening, third_party, identity, debt, dates, amounts, promise, recording, other, closing, multi>
